body.name: Exact unequal-three-arm orbit experiment
body.construction: For \(m\in\mathcal M_{n,3}\), \(r\in\mathcal R_{n,3}\), and \(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\in\prod_{a=1}^3\{0,\ldots,r_a\}\), let \(\mathcal H(m,r,x^{\mathrm{obs}})\) contain the nonnegative integer tables \(H=(H_{t,a})\) satisfying \(\sum_aH_{t,a}=m_t\), \(\sum_tH_{t,a}=r_a\), and \(\sum_{t:t_a=1}H_{t,a}=x_a^{\mathrm{obs}}\). Define \[P_m(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid r)=\frac{\prod_{a=1}^3r_a!}{n!}\sum_{H\in\mathcal H(m,r,x^{\mathrm{obs}})}\prod_{t\in\{0,1\}^3}\frac{m_t!}{\prod_{a=1}^3H_{t,a}!},\qquad \tau_{c^\dagger}(m)=\frac1n\sum_{t\in\{0,1\}^3}m_t(c^\dagger)^\top t.\]
